description: Follow-up to defk-wnu (owner 2026-10-26: option 2 after option 1). Apple clang 21 on arm64 accepts -falign-loops=64 and -falign-functions=64 and emits .p2align 6 for them. Measure with bench/layout_noise.exs whether the layout-noise range shrinks with the flags, and what they cost, by the @cflags rule in lib/defk/build.ex (7 interleaved rounds, 2% bar). Changing @cflags rebuilds every cached kernel. Done when the result is recorded in docs/performance.md and the flags are adopted or rejected with the numbers.
title: Try -falign-loops/-falign-functions in the NIF build, measured against the layout-noise band
